entries:
Alpha 1.58.3 (lighter equipped heroes)

  • Balanced release checks: Interface checks now share the existing three GitHub-hosted CI jobs, with whole-file suites preserved and every case scheduled exactly once. No test coverage or release gate was removed.
  • Less rendering work: Compatible opaque fitted armor shares draw calls while preserving the supplied models, materials, animated surfaces and independent skeletons. The controlled equipped crowd used about 18–20% fewer draw calls; this is not a universal FPS promise.
  • Stealth stays clear: Rogues temporarily use the original individual transparent pieces during stealth, then restore the opaque batches. Textured, transparent and custom-shader pieces stay separate.
  • Honest Low detail: Saved Low graphics and mobile actor loading use the delivered Low bodies. Changing detail offers an optional reload when existing bodies do not match; lighting and effects still change immediately. Medium retains High bodies on desktop.
  • Existing progress preserved: No account reset, combat, class rules, reward or currency changes. Broad performance and physical-phone checks remain separate. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.58.2 (fitted heroes and dual-wield Rogues)

  • Your new heroes: Fighter, Rogue, Wizard and Cleric now use the delivered rigged character models at High and Low quality, with independent skeletons and a procedural fallback if a model cannot load.
  • Gear that fits: All 36 base wearable items select the matching class fit or calibrated weapon grip from the 252-model collection. Standard and Legendary variants, paired rings and trinkets, covered skin and hair, mixed outfits, and robe/skirt layering are supported. Equipment loads on demand and does not change another player's model.
  • Class equipment rules: Wizards wear cloth; Rogues wear cloth or leather; Fighters and Clerics can wear every armor type. Rogues cannot use staves or equip shields/tomes offhand. Fighters and Clerics may use every weapon. Invalid saved gear stays recoverable in your bag controls and grants no stats while inactive.
  • Two weapons, faster strikes: Rogues with two valid weapons use two-thirds of their normal basic-attack interval and alternate main-hand and offhand attack motions. This speeds the existing single-hit attack; it does not create two damage events. Inspect a weapon and choose Equip offhand, or drag it to that slot. Weapon-specific idle, movement, block and attack motions follow your equipped gear.
  • Hits match the motion: Reviewed weapon attacks, including both Rogue hands, reach their visible contact pose at the existing basic-attack damage point. Damage timing and amounts are unchanged.
  • Existing progress preserved: No account reset, currency grants, loot-rate or campaign changes. The level-up and Well Rested polish from 1.58.1 remains. Final art approval, crowd performance and physical-phone dungeon checks remain separate work. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.58.1 (brighter celebrations and sanctuary light)

  • A level worth celebrating: Level-ups send gold and elemental sparks spiraling upward through a soft light column, with an expanding ground pulse. The effect follows your character instead of staying behind when you move.
  • A richer Well Rested aura: Soft star-shaped motes rise above layered golden filigree with Earth, Air, Fire and Water accents. The aura stays open around the character rather than forming a solid enclosure.
  • Readable at gameplay zoom: Spark sizing follows the actual camera projection and drawing-buffer size. Low quality uses fewer sparks; reduced motion removes spinning beams, orbital movement and expanding pulses. Celebrations retire their effects after three seconds.
  • Presentation only: Healing, Well Rested power and duration, XP, rewards, currencies, character saves and open-alpha access are unchanged. This patch does not include new Rogue, Cleric or Wizard models; those swaps await the supplied exports. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.58.0 (choose your next adventure)

  • Endgame at a glance: At level 100, the Dungeon Guide gains an Endgame tab covering the Chronicle, repeat runs, weekly cache, Resonance, Forge and collections. Goals are optional choices, not another daily checklist or quest-tracker requirement.
  • Your actual story stage: The guide explains the next step using your server-reported crystal, expedition, Nexus and finale progress. Only your personally claimed Dark King quest means the Chronicle is complete; a boss kill alone cannot claim it for you.
  • Clear reward boundaries: Weekly cache status distinguishes available, claimed and unavailable eligibility, with its Monday UTC reset. You may still help a raid after claiming; resetting a run cannot reset the reward limit. Normal, Heroic and Mythic reward sources remain separate from optional daily quests.
  • Long-term goals without EP power: Review earned Resonance in Character, choose Forge upgrades at your own pace and collect wardrobe looks without consuming gear. +20 potency remains a long-term endgame goal, not a campaign requirement. EP cannot buy combat gear or trait points.
  • Clean screen handoffs: Keyboard-accessible tabs and phone-sized buttons take you to existing run choices, Character and the world atlas without starting a run or spending resources. Reopen the guide to refresh its eligibility snapshot. Reward values, story gates, character saves and open-alpha access are unchanged. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.57.0 (discover the next world event)

  • Plan your route: The world atlas shows the current event and the next three server-scheduled events, with UTC windows, realm objectives, recommended levels and personal waypoints. Scheduled windows do not spawn enemies early or become active from a client timer.
  • Four distinct wards: Root, Tide, Ember and Gale retain their different positioning objectives. The nearby event panel explains the ward, upcoming event and normal rewards without adding another quest-tracker entry.
  • Rewards without another chore: Event enemies use normal loot and nearby party XP. Clearing the champion calms nearby hazards for five minutes; there is no extra completion purse or reward to claim. The panel stops calling hazards calmed when that window ends.
  • Bounded crowds and quiet roads: Empty events wait for nearby living adventurers and expire without spawning waves. Existing wave and champion scaling remains capped; additional players cannot speed up the ward. Prepared checks cover all four realm mechanics, not proof of final human cohort balance.
  • Preserved progress: Reward rates, Gold/EP separation, character saves and open-alpha access are unchanged. The Fighter asset documentation now reflects its already-live rigged integration. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.56.0 (earned arena looks)

  • Wear your season medal: Settled Bronze, Silver and Gold arena records unlock matching permanent medallion looks. In town, open Character → Wardrobe → Learn owned looks, choose Neck and apply your earned appearance over compatible equipped gear. Current projections cannot unlock a look.
  • Cosmetics, not power: Medallions have distinct metal, rim and crest geometry, including fitted rendering on the rigged Fighter. They are not sold for EP and do not change combat gear, stats, Gold, EP or Honor. Repeat claims do not grant extra copies or currency.
  • Understand the season: Arena rules show the existing UTC-quarter calendar, exact qualification thresholds, rating reset and retained Honor. Only the highest qualifying tier pays. Opening/joining the arena or collecting wardrobe looks after the quarter ends checks durable settlement; pending results and unavailable profiles cannot grant unverified looks.
  • Keep competition fair: Existing practice/ranked separation, team-average rating changes, repeated-opponent limits, forfeit treatment and one-time season settlement remain unchanged. No new calendar, manual reset or prize-rate change. Real-season operations and human balance review remain separate gates, not claims proved by browser fixtures.
  • Preserved progress: Character saves, real equipment, wallets and open-alpha access are unchanged. This is not final modern-art approval or physical-phone certification. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.55.0 (follow every arena round)

  • Steady arena clocks: Queue waiting and active match timers count down or advance each second without extra per-second network requests. Search windows still show the server's actual value; reaching a match deadline waits for the authoritative result.
  • Clear queue eligibility: A visible countdown explains the five-minute ranked-leaver restriction and disables ranked and practice entry until it expires. Teammates are not penalized for another player's departure. The server rechecks every request.
  • See the whole team: A compact roster shows both teams and each player's Standing, Eliminated or Finished state. Long names fit narrow screens, and queue, leave and forfeit controls have phone-sized targets.
  • Refreshes that respect your place: Authoritative updates and leaderboard refreshes preserve expanded rules, scroll position and keyboard focus. Replacement duel challenges never inherit focused consent. Closing the panel stops its clocks and queue polling; late updates cannot revive disposal.
  • Unchanged competition: Existing 1v1/2v2 team elimination, separate practice/ranked queues, rating windows, durable results and disconnect treatment remain. No combat-stat, rating, reward, Gold/EP-economy, account or open-alpha access changes. This does not claim final class balance or physical-phone certification. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.54.0 (a rigged Fighter and clearer duel consent)

  • Fighter model: The supplied rigged Fighter now appears in normal gameplay and the character preview. Independent skeletons preserve locomotion, attacks, class gestures, death and jump animations without moving authoritative player positions. Its forward strike now meets the existing basic-attack impact timing.
  • Equipment that follows the body: All 14 equipment slots fit the new rig, including shaped armor, gloves, boots, weapons, shields and accessories. Existing rarity, potency, gems, set markers and cosmetic appearances remain. Shield faces stay correctly oriented through unarmed wrist poses; casino seating bends the legs and restores the standing pose on exit.
  • Smaller on-demand assets: High and Low exports retain the full rig while reducing the supplied 40MB source to roughly 7.33MB and 3.64MB. Low detail is selected for phone loading. Independent previews, resettable quality-specific pools and an equipped procedural fallback keep loading failures from breaking the character.
  • Current duel consent: Accept and Decline belong to the current challenge. Old buttons cannot accept or consume a newer request, another challenger cannot replace an unanswered prompt, and repeated challenges do not reset its deadline. Blocking is rechecked before admission.
  • Readable and protected PvP: Challenge timers count down each second with clear phone-sized response buttons. Closed or expired prompts do not revive from late updates. Safe-zone, mutual opt-in and party protections remain; old match records cannot authorize damage in another scene, and dead players cannot enable open-world PvP.
  • Unchanged progression: No combat-stat, reward-rate, Gold/EP-economy, saved-account or open-alpha access changes. This Fighter integration is not final modern-art approval or physical-phone performance certification. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.53.0 (plan your next adventure)

  • Clear group plans: Recruitment listings include a public Lanternhold meeting point and an optional start within the next 20 minutes, shown in your local time. View the meeting point on the world map; plans never teleport you, reserve a raid seat or bypass entry requirements. Use the guild calendar for later events.
  • Useful party preparation: See the current class-role mix and ready count alongside the role being sought. The Dark King raid is now in the activity catalogue. Changed membership or leadership clears old readiness and requires a fresh check.
  • Current consent, not stale buttons: Replaced listings and renewed applications have new identities. Old requests, cancellations and invitations cannot act on a replacement plan. Recruitment invitations describe the activity and meeting place, and recheck the original plan and party before acceptance.
  • Invitations you can actually use: Each party invitation has its own confirmation identity. An old prompt cannot accept or consume a newer invite. Invite controls now appear above Social and remain usable at narrow phone widths; ending the session hides the consent window.
  • Real players and unchanged rules: Applicant details remain private to the leader, blocking and explicit acceptance still apply, and empty-board guidance offers useful alternatives without fake teammates. No currency, progression, saved-account or open-alpha access changes. Full previous patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.52.0 (guilds you can trust)

  • Durable guild-bank transfers: Gold and complete item stacks use one saved transfer identity. Interrupted saves and lost replies recover without duplicate deposits, withdrawals or compensating refunds. Earned item stats, potency, sockets and gems stay intact; story items remain personal.
  • Clear confirmation and retries: The bank explains pending, complete and rejected transfers. Retry Transfer sends the same request, including after a page reload; uncertain transfers disable new bank actions until their outcome is confirmed.
  • Recovery before play: Login, reconnect and affected character actions wait for unsettled bank work. Unrelated players keep playing. Guild membership and permissions cannot change underneath a reserved transfer.
  • Deliberate guild decisions: Leaving, disbanding, kicking, rank changes, leadership transfer and inactive-leader claims show named consequences and require confirmation. Fresh roster updates cancel stale confirmations. Invitations and calendar sign-ups still require player consent.
  • Useful officer audit: Entries identify the actor, target, time and transfer amount or item; new rank changes record the previous and new rank. Existing rank permissions, succession rules, scheduling and moderation/report controls remain authoritative.
  • Unchanged progression: No balance, reward-rate, EP-economy or closed-beta access changes. Saved progress is preserved. Full prior patch history remains below.
